hooks.name: Task Progress Tracker
hooks.description: Parses tasks.md on every save and reports phase-by-phase progress with next action

action.prompt:
The file `.kiro/specs/aeroicing-watch/tasks.md` was just saved. Parse the task checklist and report progress.

**Instructions:**
1. Count all tasks marked `[x]` (done) and `[ ]` (pending) across all phases.
2. Identify which phase is currently active (the first phase that has any `[ ]` tasks remaining).
3. Identify the next concrete task to work on (first `[ ]` in the active phase).
4. Check if any `[x]` tasks were added since the last state (new completions).
5. Report in this format:

---
## 📊 AeroIcing Watch — Task Progress

**Overall:** X / Y tasks complete (N%)

| Phase | Status | Done / Total |
|---|---|---|
| Phase 1 — Project Scaffold | ✅ Complete | 7 / 7 |
| Phase 2 — GK-2A Integration | 🔄 In Progress | 0 / 5 |
| Phase 3 — Route Sampler + Engine | ⏳ Pending | 0 / 4 |
| Phase 4 — API Router | ⏳ Pending | 0 / 3 |
| Phase 5 — Frontend | ⏳ Pending | 0 / 5 |
| Phase 6 — Polish + Git | ⏳ Pending | 0 / 6 |

**Active phase:** Phase 2 — GK-2A Integration Layer
**Next task:** 2.1 Port gk2a_cloud.py and inline overlay_fetcher dependencies

**Acceptance checklist:** X / Y items checked

---

If the active phase just had a task newly checked off, also add:
> ✅ **Just completed:** [task description] — [brief note on what this unblocks]

If the entire project is done (all tasks checked):
> 🎉 All tasks complete. Ready for hackathon submission.
